mxCell.value: Entity Relationship Diagram of the AFN Service Management System

Every diamond sits on the path between its two entities; cardinality (1, 0..1, N) is printed beside each diamond. Audit-trail links to User (created by, updated by, reviewed by, voided by, and similar) are omitted for readability.
Complete DBML scope: 53 entities, 324 attributes, and 88 relationships. Underlined attributes are primary keys.
